messages.subject: S2 done
messages.body: Implemented S2 test-first on branch fleet/build-s2 (head 5afaf7c, not pushed): update_text in toc.py, plus --check, in-place write and a 1..6 --max-depth argparse check in cli.py, covering AC-1/4/5/6. Full suite is green (60 tests via python3 -m unittest discover, including idempotence, check exit codes, placement and depth tests); ruff is not installed so lint was not run. Unbalanced toc markers are a clean error (exit 2) and CRLF is preserved; --stdout still prints only the TOC as in S1; per-file exit aggregation (AC-7) is left for another slice. Files modified: mdtoc/cli.py, mdtoc/toc.py, tests/test_update.py.
